name: qa
description: Implementation (commit as post) -> QA review -> PR flow with automatic revision requests for weak testing

stages.name: in progress
stages.description: Agent implements the task, then commits as the stage's tail work

post.name: commit
post.prompt: Commit the relevant work for this task before QA review. Original task: $TASK_PROMPT

stages.name: review
stages.description: QA agent checks whether sufficient tests exist before PR creation
stages.prompt: Review branch $BRANCH for task quality and test coverage against base $BASE_REF. Original task: $TASK_PROMPT.

stages.name: pr
stages.description: Agent creates a GitHub PR after QA passes
stages.prompt: Create a PR for the QA-approved work on branch $BRANCH.

post_action.name: approve
post_action.prompt: Approve the PR for branch $BRANCH after PR creation. Previous result: $PREV_RESULT
